games.summary: Brisbane Lions enter as strong favourites, rated 18.8pts superior by Wheelo with a dominant W3 winning streak. The Squiggle weighted consensus has BRI by 19.5pts with 100% model agreement. However, multiple adjustments bring the margin down: Melbourne's ODELO net advantage at the MCG (+9.9pts above BRI's lift), Melbourne's bounce-back after a humbling 45pt loss to Essendon, and Brisbane's 1374km travel penalty. Gawn (SC avg 140) dominates the ruck battle, and MEL's tackle pressure (+10.6 diff) could grind this into a contested arm-wrestle. Rain forecast (4mm) further suppresses scoring. BRI still win but not by as much as the market suggests.

games.summary: Fremantle are overwhelming favourites in a Western Derby at Optus Stadium where they've won the last 3 straight with an average margin of 40.7pts. Their ODELO net lift of +23.8 at this venue (16 games, 12W-4L) is extraordinary — this is effectively a home game for FRE. All 31 Squiggle models agree with Fremantle, and the top 3 (Wheelo 44.0, Holy Grail 42.2, Drop Kick 48.2) all forecast massive wins. Luke Jackson (SC avg 122.8) dominates the ruck, flowing through FRE's clearance (+7.2 differential) and inside 50 dominance. West Coast's -713 metres gained differential and 30.7% I50 efficiency conceded tells the full story — they simply cannot stop FRE's ball movement.
